description: This file is a React component named 'OnboardingModal' designed for displaying onboarding and password reset links via a modal dialog. It manages the creation and copying of invitation or reset password URLs and utilizes external libraries like React, antd, react-copy-to-clipboard, and Tremor for UI elements and clipboard functionality.

methods.name: OnboardingModal
methods.description: React functional component rendering a modal with invitation or reset password links, handling URL generation and user interactions.

methods.name: getInvitationUrl
methods.description: Constructs and returns the appropriate invitation or reset password URL based on props and invitation data.

methods.name: handleInvitationOk
methods.description: Closes the modal when the 'OK' action is triggered.

methods.name: handleInvitationCancel
methods.description: Closes the modal when the cancel action is triggered.
